metadata.scope: Offline condition-blinded semantic assessment of the complete Juanita packet. The reviewer participated in corpus authoring; this is not independent clinical validation. All 35 earlier judgments and reasons remain identical; only the 21 new complete responses were newly assessed. No reports, condition mappings, run data, other-profile resources or results, or provider logs were read. No provider calls were made.
metadata.method: Each new complete answer was read against its question, cited source-based gold, and the unchanged frozen rubric. Object association, current/past and completed/planned status, actual agreement, and appropriate abstention were assessed semantically rather than by word presence alone.
metadata.ambiguity_note: Nessuna ambiguità nelle 21 risposte nuove: un errore è null su un orario specificato; il secondo attribuisce al presente lo stato iniziale di nessun esercizio completato, superato dalla successiva dichiarazione di completamento. I 35 giudizi precedenti sono invariati.
